rotowire.headline: Porzingis is out indefinitely due to an undisclosed issue, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
rotowire.story: Porzingis will miss the start of training camp due to an unknown issue, and his status for the beginning of the regular season is murky. If the veteran big man is forced to miss time at the start of the campaign, Al Horford and Charles Bassey would be candidates for increased playing time.
rotowire.description: Porzingis is out indefinitely due to an undisclosed issue, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

fantasy.projection: Porzingis is one of the elite per-minute producers of his generation, but injuries have consistently derailed his availability and is already out for training camp. Porzingis missed 50 games last season and 40 the season before, and has missed at least 16 games in nine straight seasons. He is slotted to be the Warriors' starting center this season, and when he plays he will produce, but he is risky to draft in fantasy leagues before the late-middle rounds at the earliest.
